name: ForwardOrder
description: Forward a sales order to another user, colleague, or handler in the system for further review, processing, or approval. Trigger this function when the user wants to hand over, transfer, reassign, or delegate an order. DO NOT call this function if either order_id OR the target recipient (forward_to_user) is missing. Include honorifics/titles as-is (e.g., 'bàn giao cho anh Minh Tuấn' → forward_to_user: 'anh Minh Tuấn').

order_id.description: The unique sales order identifier in SAP (e.g., 'ORD-123456' or '0000005001') to be forwarded. Must be explicitly stated by the user.

forward_to_user.description: The identifier of the target recipient: username, full name, or email address (e.g., 'Jane Doe', 'manager.alex', 'sarah.nguyen@corp.com'). Pass exactly as stated by the user, including honorifics.
